change: Reconcile unfinished stopped Herdr executions through the prior protected Daemon configuration and existing completion transactions. Carry unsent queues, replies and callbacks only through a verified recovery operation with exact old/new configuration fingerprints and confirmed resumed sessions.
behavior: Validate every old execution owner and dispatch proof before terminal reconciliation; do not spawn or prompt providers in the offline actor.
Reuse explicit correlated terminal Pi/Codex history. Without authoritative completion, return incomplete with automatic replay disabled; side effects may already exist.
Reuse owned-scope reconciliation for protocol workers, including authenticated terminal snapshots, cancellation and uncertain reply-delivery fences.
Retain genuinely unsent queued tasks in their mailbox order and use existing completion/callback transactions for exactly one continuation.
Require a recovery receipt bound to the old protected configuration, new configuration, operation, namespace and resumed sessions; preserve ordinary configuration-change blockers.
Keep the quiescence requirement for restarting only a daemon while its old terminal providers remain alive.
Retry transient Windows state-reader sharing/access errors for at most 200 ms. Persistent failures, linked paths and malformed JSON still fail.

validation.release: 100 passed in 588.16 seconds, covering Herdr unfinished-work/reopen/stopped-server/native-host recovery, protected restart configuration, ordinary reload blockers and owned execution recovery
validation.debug: 44 passed, 1 failed in 432.18 seconds. Existing display-rebind test asserted running immediately after a bounded observation expired; replaced that assertion with bounded readiness observation, preserving launch-count and identity checks.
validation.rust_units: 46 passed, 2 subprocess helper entries ignored; their parent process-death tests passed
new_cases: Completed old child result wakes Pi Lead once; queued A then B execute once in original order
Uncertain old child returns interruption, wakes Pi Lead, and is not replayed
Opener process death after reconciliation and an agent launch does not duplicate child work, continuation or launches
Changed model/environment, corrupt dispatch identity, malformed cancellation intent or mismatched lease/config generation refuse recovery
Committed silent cancellation remains cancelled without a generated reply

limits: This does not provide exactly-once external side effects. Unconfirmed old execution or reply delivery remains uncertain rather than being automatically retried.
Running deferred-discovery terminal jobs without a fixed immutable history_binding are still conservatively refused; this increment covers fixed-history terminal dispatch and owned protocol recovery.
Claude transcript candidates without independently captured idle/terminal evidence are interrupted rather than reported successful.

The new unfinished-work path uses controlled provider/Herdr fixtures and real Windows process lifetimes, not new paid model inference. Prior model-backed kill/reopen acceptance is separately scoped to bb5a0f6a.
No account-default or production Workspace migration is performed by this increment.
